fuente.titulo: Pope Leo thanks Foundation behind new Swiss Guard Barracks

titular: Pope Leo thanks donors for new Swiss Guard barracks
bajada: He praised the foundation funding the imminent reconstruction of the historic guard quarters
caption: Pope Leo XIV expressed gratitude to the Foundation for the Renovation of the Barracks of the Pontifical Swiss Guard, which has enabled the start of long-awaited construction work. He noted that while the guardsmen may never know the names of their benefactors, their generosity will not go unnoticed. Source: Vatican News, Nov 23, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: Stone courtyard near the Vatican with scaffolding around a historic barracks building under renovation, construction materials visible, a Swiss Guard figure in traditional uniform standing in the upper right third, left and center open and clear.
